rca_of_issue: admin_disputes nested-array query bug: brackets in the tournament document is List[List[Match]] (round → matches). MongoDB dot-notation `brackets.status` only descends one level of arrays; on doubly-nested arrays it doesn't 'flatten', so `brackets.status: 'disputed'` never matches any doc. Reproduction: create tournament, register 2 players, start, both participants report DIFFERENT winners → match.status becomes 'disputed' in DB, but GET /api/admin/disputes returned tournament_matches: []. Fix: `{'brackets': {'$elemMatch': {'$elemMatch': {'status': 'disputed'}}}}` — outer $elemMatch iterates rounds, inner $elemMatch iterates matches within a round. Verified: TestTournamentE2E::test_tournament_report_dispute_and_admin_resolve now passes (disputed match is visible → admin resolves → tournament completes with correct winner).
